entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
The reckoning of the people is near, and they have turned their faces in negligence.
When new advice comes to them from their Lord; consequently, they do not listen to it except in a playful manner.

Their hearts are involved in play, and the unjust consulted with each other secretly; that 'Who is this, is he merely another a human like you? So, do you go to (him because of his) magic whilst you are seeing (it)?'
The Beloved Prophet (Muhammad) said, 'My Lord knows every word (spoken) in the heavens and in the earth, and only He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.'

Rather, they said, 'These (revelations) are confusing dreams; rather, it is his fabrication. Rather, he is a poet; (if he is a Prophet) he must therefore bring us some sign, just like the former had been sent (with miracles).'
No (people of any) town which We destroyed before them believed; so, will they believe?
And We did not send (Prophets) before you except men, to whom We sent revelations. Therefore, O people! Ask the people of knowledge if you do not know.
And We did not create them as mere bodies that ate no food, and (nor did we make them) to live in the world forever.
We then fulfilled Our promise to them; We henceforth rescued them and whoever (else) We willed, and destroyed the transgressors.
We have indeed sent down towards you a Book (O people of Quraish), in which is your (potential) glorification; so, do you not have sense?
And how many towns We have destroyed that were unjust, and We created another nation after them.
And when they received Our punishment, they immediately started fleeing therefrom.
'Do not flee, and return to the comforts that were given to you and to your homes; perhaps you will be asked.'
They said, 'Woe to us! We were indeed unjust.'
So, they kept saying this until We made them cut-off (i.e. like chopped-off crop), extinguished.
And We have not created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in vain.
(Hypothetically) had We willed to choose any amusement, We could have chosen it from Ourselves, if We wanted to do so.
Rather, We strike falsehood with the truth, it therefore knocks out its brains; thereupon it vanishes. And woe to you for those utterances which you fabricate (concerning Allah).
And only to Him belong all those who are in the heavens and in the earth, and those (angels) with Him are not arrogant towards worshipping Him, nor do they tire.
They glorify Him night and day; and they are not lazy (in this regard).
Have they appointed from the earth some such gods; that they create something?

If there were gods other than Allah in the heavens and the earth, they would have therefore definitely been destroyed. Thus, Purity be to Allah; Master of the Throne, from the matters that they fabricate.
He (Allah) is not to be questioned what He does, and they (the people) will all be questioned.

Have they taken other gods except Allah? Say you (O Beloved), 'Bring your proof. This Qur'aan is the remembrance of those who are with me and the remembrance of those before me.' Rather, most of them do not know the truth; hence, they turn away (from it).
And We did not send any Messenger before you but We would reveal to him that 'There is no god except Me; hence, only worship Me.'
And they (the disbelievers) said, 'The Most Gracious has chosen a son; Purity is to Him. Rather, they (the angels) are honourable bondsmen.'
They do not precede Him in speech, and they act upon only His command.
He knows what is in front of them and what is behind them, and they do not intercede except for him whom He (Allah) likes, and they are in fear of His Awe.
And the one amongst them who says, 'I am a god other than Allah,' We shall consequently recompense him with Hell; this is how We punish the transgressors.

Did the disbelievers not perceive that the heavens and the earth were closed up (as one piece), We henceforth opened (i.e. parted) them, and We made every living thing from water. So, will they not believe?
And We have placed (mountains as) anchors in the earth, that it may not tremble with them (people). And We kept wide paths therein, that they may find their way.
And We have made the sky a protected roof; and they turn away from its signs (i.e. sun, moon, wind, clouds, etc.).
And it is He Who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon; each one floats in an orbit.
And, before you, We did not make in the world a never-ending life for any human. So, will they remain eternally if you (O Beloved) depart (from this world)?
Every soul must taste the flavour of death, and We test you with evil and with good for a trial, and only to Us are you to return.
And when the disbelievers see you, they do not take you but as a mockery (saying to each other), 'Is he the one who speaks ill of your gods?' And they deny the remembrance of the Most Gracious.
Mankind has been made to be hasty. I shall now show you My signs; do not be hasty with Me.
And they say, 'When will this promise (of punishment) occur, if you are truthful?'
Had the disbelievers somehow known the time when they will not be able to stop the Fire from their faces, and nor from their backs, and nor are they to be helped.
Rather, it will come upon them suddenly; it will hence make them dumbfounded; they will then not be able to reverse it, nor will they be given respite.
And indeed, the Messengers before you were mocked but the mockery of those who mocked encompassed themselves.
Say you (O Beloved), 'Who guards you night and day from (the punishment of) the Most Gracious?' Rather, they have turned away their faces from the remembrance of their Lord.
Do they have some gods who protect them from Us? They cannot save themselves, nor do they have an alliance with Us.

Rather, We have given those (disbelievers) and their forefathers a benefit to the extent that life became long for them. So, do they not see that We are reducing the land (of the disbelievers) from its borders (by giving victory to the believers)? So, will they be dominant?
Say you (O Beloved), 'I warn you only through revelation, and the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.'
And if a breath of your Lord's punishment was to touch them, they would hence definitely say, 'Woe to us! We were indeed unjust.'

And We shall establish the scales of justice on the Day of Resurrection, no soul will therefore be wronged in the least. And if there be anything even equal to a mustard seed, We will henceforth bring it, and We are Sufficient to take account.
And We indeed gave Moosa and Haaroon judgement (i.e. the Tawrah), and light, and advice for the pious.
Those who fear their Lord without seeing and they are afraid of the Last Day.
This is a blessed remembrance which We have sent down. Are you deniers thereof?
And We indeed bestowed upon Ibrahim his righteous path from the beginning, and We were Aware of him.
When he said to his father and his people, 'What are these idols in front of whom you are sitting devotedly (to worship)?'
They said, 'We found our forefathers worshipping them.'
He (Ibrahim) said, 'Indeed, you and your forefathers are all in open error.'
They said, 'Have you brought the truth to us, or are you just playing?'
He said, 'Rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth; the One Who created them. And I am amongst the witnesses to this.'
'And I swear an oath by Allah, I shall seek to harm your idols after you have turned your backs.'
He therefore crushed them all except the biggest amongst them; that perhaps they may question it.
They said, 'Who has done this to our gods? He is indeed unjust.'
Some amongst them said, 'We heard a young man speak ill of them; the one called Ibrahim.'
They said, 'So, bring him in front of the people; perhaps they may testify.'
They said, 'Did you do this to our gods, O Ibrahim?'
Said he, 'Rather, this big one from them must have done it; so, question them, if they speak.'
They therefore turned to themselves (realising their own falsehood) and said (to one another), 'Indeed, only you are unjust.'
They were then made to reverse on their heads (i.e. baffled with embarrassment and said); that '(O Ibrahim!) You know well that they do not speak.'
He (Ibrahim) said, 'Do you worship other than Allah who neither benefits you nor harms you.'
'Shame on you and on those idols whom you worship instead of Allah; so, do you not have intellect?'
They said, 'Burn him and help your gods, if you are to do (something).'
We said, 'O fire! Become cool and peaceful upon Ibrahim.'
And they wished to cause him harm, We consequently made them the greatest of losers.
And We rescued him and Loot towards that land in which We have placed blessings for the worlds.
And We bestowed upon him Is-haaq, and Ya'qoob; the grandson (of Ibrahim), and We made all of them worthy of Our special proximity.
And We made them leaders; that they call by Our command, and We sent them revelation to do good deeds, and to keep Salah established and to pay Zakah; and they would worship Us.
And We gave Loot governance and knowledge, and We rescued him from (the people of) that town which had been doing evil deeds; indeed, those evil people were disobedient.
And We admitted him into Our Mercy; indeed, he is amongst those who deserve Our special proximity.
And (remember) Nooh when he called Us before this, We henceforth answered his supplication, and rescued him and his household from the extreme calamity.
And We helped him against the people who belied Our verses; indeed, they were evil people, We consequently drowned them all.

And remember Dawood and Sulaimaan; when they were deciding the dispute of a crop-field, when some people's goats had strayed therein at night; and We were Present (with Our knowledge and power) at the time of their judgement.

And We made Sulaimaan understand the matter (of the goats), and to both We gave kingdom and knowledge, and made the mountains subservient that they would proclaim Purity along with Dawood, and (also subjected) the birds; and these were Our actions.
And We taught him (Dawood) to make a garment (i.e. armour) for you, to protect you from your injury (in wars). So, will you be grateful?
And We made the strong wind subservient to Sulaimaan, that it would blow by his command towards the land in which We have placed blessing; and We know everything.
And amongst the devils were those who would dive (in the water) for him and would do works other than this; and We had kept them restrained.
And (remember) Ayyoob (Job), when he called his Lord; that 'Distress has afflicted me, and You are the Most Merciful of all those who show mercy.'

We henceforth answered his supplication; so, We removed the adversity that had afflicted him, and We gave him his family, and in addition, bestowed along with them more of a similar number by Mercy from Ourselves, and advice for the people who worship.
And (remember) Isma'eel, and Idrees and Zul-Kifl; all of them were patient.
And We admitted them into Our Mercy; indeed, they are amongst those who deserve Our special closeness.

And (remember) Zun-Noon (i.e. the Prophet Yunus) when he departed full of anger, assuming that We would not restrict him; he therefore called out in (the realms of) darkness, 'There is no god except You; Glory be to You. Indeed, an out-of-place (act) occurred from me.'
We henceforth heard his call and rescued him from grief, and We shall similarly rescue the Muslims.
And (remember) Zakariyya when he called his Lord, 'O my Lord, do not leave me alone (i.e. childless), and You are the Best Inheritor (i.e. Eternal).'

We henceforth accepted his supplication, and bestowed upon him Yahya, and improved the condition of his wife for him (i.e. from being infertile to fertile). Indeed, they (the aforementioned Prophets) would hurry to perform good deeds, and they proclaimed to Us with hope and fear, and are humble in Our Majestic Court.
And remember the Lady (Maryam) who guarded her chastity, We henceforth breathed Our (Special) Spirit into her and made her and her son a sign for the entire world.
Indeed, this religion of yours (i.e. Islam) is the one religion (of all the Prophets), and I am your Lord; hence, worship Me.
And others have split up their matter (i.e. religion) into pieces amongst themselves. All are to return to Us.
So, whosoever does some good deeds and is a believer, his effort will not therefore be disregarded; and We are recording it.
And it is unlawful for (the people of) such a town which We have destroyed that they may return back.
Until the time when Ya'jooj and Ma'jooj will be released, and they will be coming down from every height.

And the true promise (of the Day of Judgement) has come near, the eyes of the disbelievers will thereupon remain wide open; (saying) that 'Woe to us! Undoubtedly, we were heedless of this; rather, we were unjust.'
'Indeed, you and all that you worship other than Allah are the fuel of Hell; you are to go therein.'
'Had these been gods, they would not have gone into Hell, and they are all to abide therein forever.'
They will bray (like donkeys) therein and not be able to hear anything in it.
Indeed, those to whom Our promise of goodness (i.e. Paradise) has been made, they have been kept far away from Hell.
And they will not hear its faintest sound, and they will forever abide in (bounties) which their hearts desire.
The greatest fear will not aggrieve them, and the angels will welcome them; (saying) that 'This is that Day of yours which you were promised.'

The Day when We shall roll up the heavens as the angel Sijill rolls up the books of deeds. Just like We made it first, We shall similarly restore it; this is a promise upon Our responsibility, We shall certainly do it.
And We indeed wrote, after the admonition in the Zaboor, that 'My virtuous bondsmen will inherit this earth.'
Indeed, this Qur'aan is sufficient for the worshippers.
And We did not send you (O Beloved) but as mercy for all the worlds.
Say you (O Beloved), 'I receive only this revelation; that you have no god but One Allah, do you therefore become Muslims?'

Then, if they turn away their faces (from Islam); so, say (O Beloved), 'I have declared a war against you on equal terms, and what do I know (without being informed by Allah) whether the promise which is given to you is close or afar?'
'Indeed, Allah knows whatever is said loudly, and knows what you conceal.'
'And what do I know (on my own accord); it may be a trial for you, and an enjoyment for just a while.'

And the Beloved Prophet (Muhammad) submitted that 'O my Lord, make true judgement (between me and the deniers). And only the help of our Lord; the Most Gracious, is required against that which you fabricate.'
